title: 第18章 屠杀第19章 巢穴
slug: 异界冒险从组建冒险团开始
content_zh:
尖锐而邪恶，如同指甲剐蹭玻璃般的恶魔语，令所有士兵眉头微皱，产生些许生理不适感。
几秒钟后，见探路的哥布林没死，手持半截草叉的哥布林首领立刻带着大部队冲了出来！
“哇！”
一群对三个，优势在我！
哥布林们对现场形势有了共识，立刻撒丫子冲向那两只散发极度诱惑气息的母羊。
沃尔见大群哥布林发动冲锋并没有丝毫慌乱，还能冷静地默数：
“18只哥布林，很好！”
哥布林们努力地倒腾两条短腿，但速度只是和普通人慢跑差不多，如果在复杂环境中，这些皮糙肉厚的魔物还有点威胁，但现在可是开阔的平坦地形。
跑了几秒，哥布林们完全离开了森林笼罩的范围，从一人多高的青草堆旁跑过，完全没注意到就站在那后面的士兵。
他们眼里只有那两只母羊。
到了距离沃尔二十米左右，哥布林们才发现，挡在它们与母羊之间那三个碍事的人类，是零碎的恶魔传承中所说的披甲战士，很是强大。
“抛射！”
哥布林首领立刻用怪异的声音大叫着，所有哥布林慢下脚步，向沃尔三人抛射出手中的石块和骨片。
噼啪～
沃尔轻轻挥动尖刃斧枪，飞向他的几颗石块立刻弹到一边，霍恩和扎木合被几颗有着尖锐棱角的骨片投中，但被锁子甲轻松挡下，些许冲击力也被内层绵甲缓冲，没有受到任何伤害。
见哥布林再次发起冲锋，位置已经超过了最后的青草垛，沃尔立刻大吼道：
“杀！”
早已蓄势待发的士兵们接到命令立刻有了动作。
“杀！杀！杀！”
大喝一声后，他们平举尖刃斧枪，就像无数次练习那样，迈着沉稳而迅捷的步伐，开始向最近的哥布林发动进攻！

哗啦啦——
锁子甲轻微响动声连成一片，瞬间将哥布林部队包围。
哥布林那被混乱欲望充斥的脑袋怎么也不明白，这些穿着铁甲的人类是怎么出现在自己身边的。
惊惧之下，哥布林群的冲锋瞬间混乱起来，有的哥布林繁殖欲望压迫大脑继续冲锋，有的哥布林试图躲在同伴身后暂避锋芒，原本散乱的阵型反而稍微聚拢。
哥布林慌乱起来，本来还有些紧张的士兵就不再像刚才那么紧张了。
几只反应较慢的哥布林第一时间便被尖刃斧枪的长刃刺中，有着邪恶力量庇护的厚皮也无法抵挡士兵们迅猛刺出的尖刃斧枪，锋利枪尖落下，黑绿色血液喷洒而出！
“啊！——”
尖锐的哀嚎响彻，得到战果的士兵却更加兴奋，手中猛然用力，尖刃斧枪的利刃瞬间撕裂哥布林那矮小的身躯，血液和脏器洒落一地。
其他士兵也并没有胡乱冲入哥布林群，而是步伐稳健地向前移动，锋利的枪尖对准哥布林的胸膛，估算着距离，时刻准备发动迅猛一击。
哥布林们在短暂混乱后，突然发现自己身边还有着许多同伴，而沃尔安排的士兵们却分散开来。
哥布林的智慧告诉它们，自己的同伴多，对面的敌人少，优势在我！
content_en:
The devil's words were sharp and evil, like fingernails scraping against glass, causing all the soldiers to frown slightly and feel some physical discomfort.
A few seconds later, seeing that the goblin exploring the path was not dead, the goblin leader holding half a pitchfork immediately rushed out with a large army!
"Wow!"
One group versus three, the advantage is mine!
The goblins came to a consensus on the situation and immediately rushed towards the two ewes that exuded an extremely tempting aura.
Wall didn't panic at all when he saw the large group of goblins charging. He could still count calmly:
"18 Goblins, very good!"
The goblins were trying hard to jump on their short legs, but the speed was only about the same as ordinary people jogging. If they were in a complex environment, these thick-skinned monsters would still be a bit of a threat, but now it was an open and flat terrain.
After running for a few seconds, the goblins completely left the scope of the forest and ran past the tall grass pile, completely unaware of the soldiers standing behind it.
They only had eyes for the two ewes.
When they arrived about twenty meters away from Wall, the goblins discovered that the three human beings standing in the way between them and the ewes were the armored warriors mentioned in the fragmented demon inheritance, and they were very powerful.
"Projection!"
The goblin leader immediately shouted in a weird voice, and all the goblins slowed down and threw stones and bone fragments in their hands at the three Walls.
crackle~
Wall gently waved the sharp-edged ax gun, and several stones flying towards him immediately bounced aside. Horn and Zamuhe were hit by several bone fragments with sharp edges, but they were easily blocked by the chain armor. Some of the impact was also buffered by the inner layer of cotton armor, and they did not suffer any damage.
Seeing that the Goblin was charging again and had already surpassed the last haystack, Wall immediately shouted:
"Kill!"
The soldiers who were already ready to go took action immediately after receiving the order.
"Kill! Kill! Kill!"
After shouting loudly, they raised their sharp-edged ax spears and, just like they had practiced countless times, they took steady and quick steps and began to attack the nearest goblin!
Crash--
The slight sound of chainmails rang together, instantly surrounding the Goblin troops.
The goblin's head, filled with chaotic desires, couldn't understand how these humans in iron armor appeared next to him.
In fear, the charge of the Goblin group instantly became chaotic. Some Goblins' desire to reproduce forced their brains to continue charging. Some Goblins tried to hide behind their companions to avoid the sharp attack. The originally scattered formations gathered slightly.
The goblin panicked, and the soldiers who were still a little nervous were no longer as nervous as before.
Several Goblins who reacted slowly were stabbed by the long blade of the sharp-edged ax gun at the first time. The thick skin protected by evil power could not resist the soldiers' sharp-edged ax gun. The sharp spear tip fell, and black and green blood sprayed out!
"Ah!——"
Sharp wails resounded, but the soldiers who had gained the victory were even more excited. With a sudden force in their hands, the sharp blade of the sharp-edged ax gun tore apart the Goblin's short body in an instant, and blood and organs were scattered all over the floor.
The other soldiers did not rush into the Goblin group randomly, but moved forward steadily, pointing the sharp spear tip at the Goblin's chest, estimating the distance, and were always ready to launch a swift blow.
After a brief confusion, the goblins suddenly found that they were surrounded by many companions, while the soldiers arranged by Wall dispersed.
The wisdom of goblins tells them that they have more companions and fewer enemies on the opposite side. The advantage lies with me!
